items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I think that he's my biggest success... of all the people that I've known through my bands... And then when Getz and Zoot and -- and Sam had tried to hold these guys together as far as the section was concerned

ctx.x: 'And there's a guy from -- used to be around New York, or he was in Philadelphia. He's out here now, and his name is Stan Getz.'
I see. Okay. In that band, now, what did you feel was significantly exciting compared with the first one? It had its own brand of excitement and had some of the carry-overs, some of the key people.
